card.name: Multiplier words after a number
card.fires_on: Quantity words such as fold, score, dozen or hundreds that come right after a number or an amount word like several, few or ten. Seen mostly in drug-label text on increases and multiples.

modes.label: Fold after a number
modes.description: The word fold (or -fold) follows a numeral and marks a multiple of a dose or level.
modes.example: dose should be increased up to 5<< fold>> of the original dose when used in combination

modes.label: Counting words after several or a few
modes.description: Dozen, score or hundreds follow a vague amount word such as several or a few.
modes.example: Several<< dozen>> cases have been reported in the world literature

card.plain: It marks words like fold, score or dozen that turn a number into a multiple or a rough count.
